brand.tagline: Who guards the guardian? Your rules do.

welcome.title: Invest together. Let an AI do the work. Keep it inside your rules.
welcome.lead: Plenum lets a group pool money and hand day-to-day management to an AI manager. The group writes the rules, an independent administrator prices the fund, and only verified people can put money in or take it out.

points.rules: Rules the AI can't break. Every trade is checked against your group's rules before it happens.
points.price: An independent price. A separate administrator values the fund. The AI never does.
points.people: Verified people only. Money moves only between members who have verified who they are.
points.fire: You stay in charge. Bigger moves need your approval, and members can pause the manager at any time.
